verses.text: Now listen, you rich people. Cry and scream because of the troubles that are coming to you.
Your riches have rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
Your gold and silver have rusted. That rust will be a witness against you, and it will eat your bodies like fire. You have stored up treasure in these last days.

Listen! You cheated the workers who cut your fields and did not pay them. Their pay cries out against you. The cries of those who brought in your harvest have reached the ears of the Lord of Heaven's Armies.
You have lived on earth in luxury and pleasure. You have fattened yourselves like animals ready to be killed.
You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who were not fighting against you.
So be patient, brothers and sisters, until the Lord comes back. Think about the farmer, who waits patiently for his land to give a good crop. He waits for the autumn and spring rains.
You too must be patient and keep your hearts strong, because the Lord's coming is near.
Brothers and sisters, do not complain about each other, or you will be judged. The Judge is standing at the door!
Brothers and sisters, think of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They are an example of how to suffer patiently.
We call those who stayed strong blessed. You have heard how Job kept going, and you have seen how the Lord helped him in the end. The Lord is full of kindness and mercy.
Most of all, my brothers and sisters, do not make promises by swearing, not by heaven, not by the earth, and not by anything else. Just say a simple "yes" or "no", so that you will not be judged.
Is anyone among you in trouble? They should pray. Is anyone happy? They should sing songs of praise.
Is anyone among you sick? They should call the church leaders to pray over them, and pour oil on them in the name of the Lord.
A prayer made with faith will heal the sick person, and the Lord will make them well. If they have sinned, they will be forgiven.
So tell each other your sins and pray for each other, so that you will be healed. The prayer of a person who lives right with God is very powerful.
Elijah was a human being just like us. He prayed hard that it would not rain, and no rain fell on the land for three and a half years.
Then he prayed again, and the sky sent rain, and the earth grew its crops.
My brothers and sisters, if one of you wanders away from the truth, and someone brings them back,
remember this: whoever turns a sinner away from their wrong path will save them from death, and many sins will be forgiven.
